\n

Compound words are written as one where we now write them so (shellfish, pineapple, halfway), and old words are given in ours (there for thither, until then for hitherto, every now and then for ever and anon). The prayers and the words of Scripture keep their own form. Where a word has changed its meaning since Kingston used it, as terrific has, the word we would use now stands in the text, and a small lettered note gives the word he wrote.
